items.title: How to Build a Coding Agent Harness in Go
items.blurb: Build an agent harness from scratch in Go: a chat loop, an agent loop, file and shell tools, and guardrails, running free on a local Ollama model.

items.title: Preconfigured Agents with Microsoft Agent Framework for Go
items.blurb: Use harness.AgentConfig to configure task lists, file memory, skills, approvals, conversation history, and tracing for agents written in Go.

items.title: Why Does gRPC Configure Clients with JSON?
items.blurb: gRPC's service config controls load balancing, retries, and timeouts, and in grpc-go you write it as a raw JSON string. Here's why, and why it shouldn't still be the only option.

items.title: Comparing Go GUI Frameworks: One GUI App, Built Five Ways
items.blurb: I had coding agents build the same data-heavy app with Fyne, Cogent Core, Wails, GoTTH and MIQT, then measured what a user would actually notice.
